# Release checklist: <version>

Each item: done, failed or not run.

- [ ] Typecheck and full module check
- [ ] Browser drive and screenshot
- [ ] Levels per preset
- [ ] A person listened (report linked)
- [ ] Asset rights
- [ ] Version and changelog
- [ ] Licence and credit
- [ ] Publication dry run
- [ ] Native formats built and inspected, or not promised
